title: 2026 UK GHG inventory uncertainty and measurement-verification QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Annual statement of emissions for 2024 accessible webpage

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Monitoring and Verification Programme

facts.source_fact: It is not possible to measure all national emissions directly, so the inventory relies largely on activity data and emission factors.
facts.expected_handling: Do not represent inventory estimates as universal direct measurements.

facts.source_fact: Statistical activity data used in the inventory are subject to uncertainty.
facts.expected_handling: Carry activity-data uncertainty into derived confidence.

facts.source_fact: Emission factors used in the inventory are subject to uncertainty.
facts.expected_handling: Carry factor uncertainty and provenance.

facts.source_fact: The UK inventory assesses uncertainty using internationally agreed good-practice guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the methodological standard used.

facts.source_fact: Uncertainty information helps prioritise improvements to inventory accuracy.
facts.expected_handling: Use uncertainty as a QA signal rather than hiding it.

facts.source_fact: Uncertainty analysis informs methodological choices.
facts.expected_handling: Retain uncertainty evidence when methods change.

facts.source_fact: The 2024 emissions uncertainty is reported at approximately 2.6 percent around the central estimate.
facts.expected_handling: Label this as national-inventory uncertainty, not row-level error.

facts.source_fact: The reported uncertainty range extends about 2.5 percent below the central estimate.
facts.expected_handling: Keep lower-bound direction and units.

facts.source_fact: The reported uncertainty range extends about 2.8 percent above the central estimate.
facts.expected_handling: Keep upper-bound direction and units.

facts.source_fact: The uncertainty analysis supports high confidence that UK emissions have declined since 1990.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the national trend scope and avoid parcel inference.

facts.source_fact: DESNZ has funded a Greenhouse Gas Emissions Monitoring and Verification Programme since 2011.
facts.expected_handling: Carry programme provenance with validation claims.

facts.source_fact: The verification programme uses atmospheric greenhouse-gas measurements as independent evidence.
facts.expected_handling: Distinguish top-down measurement evidence from bottom-up inventory estimates.

facts.source_fact: The monitoring programme is intended to independently verify the reported greenhouse-gas inventory.
facts.expected_handling: Do not conflate programme verification with inventory compilation.

facts.source_fact: The programme monitors atmospheric concentrations of principal gases reported in the UK greenhouse-gas inventory.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve gas-specific measurement provenance.

facts.source_fact: The programme uses measurements to infer Northern Hemisphere background concentrations.
facts.expected_handling: Keep background estimates distinct from UK source emissions.

facts.source_fact: The programme uses atmospheric data to infer UK emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Label inferred emissions as top-down estimates.

facts.source_fact: The programme seeks to infer geographical distributions of emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat inferred distributions as parcel-level measurements.

facts.source_fact: The programme seeks sector disaggregation where possible.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve uncertainty and feasibility limits on sector attribution.

facts.source_fact: Monitoring data are used to identify discrepancies with the inventory and areas for improvement.
facts.expected_handling: Record discrepancies as QA evidence rather than silently reconciling them.

facts.source_fact: The verification programme is designed as an iterative continuous improvement process.
facts.expected_handling: Version findings and avoid treating one comparison as final.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve national uncertainty and verification semantics.
Attach national, gas, sector and top-down/bottom-up scope.
Attach inventory year and programme/report vintage.
Carry activity-data, factor, IPCC and atmospheric-measurement provenance.
Do not convert national uncertainty or inferred distributions into parcel measurements.
